title: Every comment on a fetched Jira issue
description: The whole comment thread, oldest first. `total` is what Jira reported; `comments` must hold that many. A file with fewer is a truncated fetch, not a shorter thread.

summary.description: The issue's summary, repeated so this file reads on its own.

total.description: The count Jira reported. The fetch pages until it has this many, and fails rather than writing fewer.

comments.description: Oldest first, the order the conversation happened in.

body.description: The comment as markdown. Inline images resolve against the shared assets/ folder.

images.description: Images this comment references, by their path into assets/.
